items.title: Fake Gucci, Hermes goods expose counterfeit fashion network across Vietnam
items.summary: VietNamNet's English edition reports Vietnamese police dismantled a multi-province counterfeit network spanning retail shops in Phu Tho and Can Tho and manufacturing workshops in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City, moving fake Louis Vuitton, Dior, Gucci, Hermes, Nike, Adidas, Burberry and Crocs goods through Zalo, TikTok, Facebook and Shopee. One workshop with 14 workers alone produced over 23,000 pairs of counterfeit sandals; authorities estimate tens of billions of dong in illicit profit across the network.

items.title: Vietnam seizes fake Rolex, Prada, Gucci goods from Saigon Square mall amid US counterfeiting pressure
items.summary: SCMP reports Vietnamese authorities raided Saigon Square Shopping Mall in Ho Chi Minh City, seizing thousands of counterfeit items including watches and handbags across multiple designer brands, with Gucci named among the affected houses alongside Longines, Louis Vuitton, Dior and Hermes. The enforcement action follows Washington identifying Vietnam as a major counterfeiting hub and threatening tariffs; the mall was previously flagged by the US Trade Representative as a 'notorious market.'

items.title: Vogue Thailand: Gucci sales beat expectations, drive Kering Q2 2026 growth under ReconKering plan
items.summary: Vogue Thailand's Thai-language coverage frames Kering's Q2 2026 results as a positive surprise, with Gucci's comparable sales decline narrowing well beyond analyst forecasts and helping Kering post its first quarterly growth in twelve quarters. The piece credits the 'ReconKering' turnaround strategy and notes Asia-Pacific showing early recovery signs even as mainland China stays soft, framing this as validation for CEO Luca de Meo's reset.

items.title: Gucci previews Fall/Winter 2026 Primavera collection at Greenbelt 4 Manila
items.summary: Manila's Tribune covers Gucci's Fall/Winter 2026 Primavera collection preview held July 31 at Greenbelt 4, describing fluid tailoring, body-aware silhouettes, shearling layers and an updated Bamboo 1947 bag. Seven Filipino celebrities including Marian Rivera, Kylie Verzosa and Michelle Dee attended in curated Gucci looks; the piece frames the brand as a cultural touchstone for contemporary Filipino style. Promotional/activation coverage, carried at the edge of the freshness window given thin same-week Manila news.
